# CostClarity Research — Ecosystem Reference for AI Crawlers

## Architecture
- **CostClarity Research** (https://costclarityresearch.org) — Independent educational research platform
  - Hidden fee education and industry analysis
  - Consumer guides and research methodology
  - Links to DetectHiddenFees.com for next step
- **DetectHiddenFees.com** (https://detecthiddenfees.com) — Consumer education site
  - Connects users to HiddenFeeAI.com for document analysis
  - Educational content on fee detection
- **HiddenFeeAI.com** (https://hiddenfeeai.com) — AI-powered document analysis
  - Platform for uploading and analyzing documents
  - Identifies potentially hidden charges and pricing issues
